evidence.C1: "smooth sound tied to drag speed" and tumbling/water loops give strong payoffs, but the phone fold shirt looks flat and station buttons remain plain.
evidence.C2: "DRAG each coin into the slot" and "drag across it to peel the felt off" show strong gesture fidelity, though some steps are still tap-driven.
evidence.C3: Cohesive mint/cream palette and receipt detail, but tiles, machines, and HUD pills still read somewhat flat and generic.
evidence.C4: "Tap the green slot to feed in a note" plus persistent "This load" states make next steps clear, though phone fold cues could be more visually obvious.

fixes: Make smoothing and folding visibly tactile on phone: stronger wrinkle contrast, fold progress, and cloth deformation at 390 px.
Deepen materials, lighting, and HUD art direction: less flat tiles/machines, more ambient occlusion/reflections, and HUD styled as laundromat signage rather than generic pills.
Convert remaining tap-only steps into physical gestures: drag shirts into drums, pull detergent drawer, turn knob, and animate coin insertion with matched feedback.

evidence.C1: Calm mint/cream palette, visible water and foam in washer drum, tumbling shirts in dryer, drips on line, steam from dryer, 29 synthesized sound ids + ambient bed, 'Sit' station for lingering. Tactile drag cues (smooth, peel lint, drag coin) described but visual payoff of smoothing/peel not fully visible in static screenshots.
evidence.C2: Each station has its own gesture: changer note-feed + coin scoop, washer door/detergent drawer/coin drag/start, dryer coin ledge + lint trap peel, pegs on line, smoothing + sleeve/bottom folds. Receipt lists every coin and station. Matches a real neighbourhood laundry workflow.
evidence.C3: Coherent art direction: glazed ceramic tiles with grout and chips, rounded machines with rubber gaskets and brushed maker plates, 'lavanda' detergent label, green cutting mat with thirds guides, torn-zigzag receipt, film grain/vignette. City view through window reads somewhat flat/illustrated vs the otherwise deliberate craft.
evidence.C4: Always-visible one-line hint ('Tap the green slot to feed a note.', 'Drag over the lint screen to peel the felt off.', 'Now fold the right side in.'), red underline on next station, 'THIS LOAD' card tracks each shirt's state, in-scene object labels, ghost-fingertip drag cue. Phone hint shortened to one line at 390px.

fixes: Make the tumbling clothes inside the washer/dryer drums read as moving fabric (visible rotation, shifting folds, water sloshing) rather than near-static shapes — currently the drum contents look frozen in the screenshots.

Deepen the window city view: the parallax layers are described but the buildings read as flat cutouts; add window glow, lit interiors at night, or atmospheric haze so the view feels like a real neighbourhood rather than a poster.

Strengthen the visible feedback of the smoothing and lint-peel drags — show a clear trail of erased wrinkles or a peeling felt edge in real time so the tactile payoff of the gesture is obvious without relying on sound alone.

evidence.C1: Rich sensory layer: '29 one-shot sound ids... Each machine sound is placed in space', 'drips slow as it dries', steam, billow, shader foam; but the lint-screen screenshot is a bare white-floor expanse and sound pacing/quality can't be verified from stills, so 'nothing jarring / invites lingering' isn't fully demonstrated.
evidence.C2: Anchor-10 list fully covered: changer ('feed a note... coins cascade'), 'DRAG each coin into the slot', 'pour detergent into the drawer', 'pull the lint trap and drag across it to peel', pegs, smoothing, sleeve/bottom folds; held back by tap-to-load shirts and fixed machines (Washer 2, Dryer 3) rather than free machine choice.
evidence.C3: Deliberate and cohesive: 'chipped corner showing the biscuit', clearcoat enamel, 'bilas PRO 7 KG' plates, warm mint/cream palette, matching HUD; but in the phone fold shot the shirt reads as a flat white cutout with faint wrinkles, and the lint-view floor/wall areas look washed-out and empty.
evidence.C4: Persistent hint at every state ('Drag over the lint screen to peel the felt off.'), object-pinned labels ('Washer 2 · Open the door'), ghost drag cue after 1.5 s, This-load card + timers + red underline; the card shows state ('2 dry · 2 wet') but not each shirt's next destination, so next action relies on the single hint line.

fixes: Fill the sterile quiet states: the lint-screen view is mostly empty white floor and the wall right of the changer is blank — add grounded ambient detail (floor grime/reflection, a bin or bench edge, wall texture) so waiting moments stay warm, not sterile (C1, highest weight).

Fix phone craft drop-off: on the 390 px fold view the shirt reads as a flat white shape with barely visible fold relief — increase wrinkle contrast/shading at grazing angles so the 2x 'fold ribbons' read at phone distance (C3).

Deepen laundry fidelity: let shirts be dragged from basket into the drum instead of tap-loading, and let any free washer/dryer be used rather than scripted Washer 2 / Dryer 3, so gestures and choice match a real neighbourhood laundry (C2).
